blocks.x: Are we going to end? Because I – when we pick up, I’m going to ask you where you got all your business acumen that you passed on Bu?

Today is January 9th, 2009. I’m Anthony Brown. With Ken Kimery we are conducting the Smithsonian Jazz Oral History interview with composer, arranger, tenor saxophonist, and raconteur Mr. Benny Golson in his home in Los Angeles, California. This is day two of the interview. How are you doing? How are you feeling this afternoon?
